directive.name: code-review
directive.description: Perform strict architectural code review with no backwards compatibility

context.principle: No backwards compatibility - we break things and fix them properly
No deprecation notices - we delete or keep, no middle ground
Code review is adversarial - find problems, reject violations

process.rule: Run automated checks first: pnpm test, pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck
Scan for forbidden patterns before any manual review
Check architectural classification of all new/modified modules

check.reason: No deprecation notices - delete or keep, no middle ground

check.item: No backwards compatibility shims or wrappers
No feature flags for old vs new behavior
No re-exports of renamed symbols for compatibility

example.explanation: Delete oldFunction, update all callers to use newFunction
No deprecation period, just direct updates
No compatibility layers - migrate all data to new format
